system.description:
A Converged creature has been marked by stellar plasma, their form traced in its light, primed and ready to detonate when triggered by the right jutsu discipline. If the triggering jutsu has multiple discipline keywords, the triggering creature picks one.

A Converged creature that takes damage as a result of a Ninjutsu, has the plasma on them detonate inward, disrupting their chakra flow, as they increase the cost of jutsu they cast by +6 until the end of their next turn. This condition then immediately ends.

A Converged creature that takes damage or gains a condition as a result of a Genjutsu has this plasma light flare outward, feeding the radiant energy through the illusion as they cannot target creatures with positive or hostile effects, until the end of their next turn. This condition then immediately ends.

A Converged creature that takes damage or as a result of a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu becomes a jumping off point for a brutal assault as the plasma energy erupts on impact, amplifying the kinetic force of the strike. This condition then immediately ends.

if the triggering jutsu is a Taijutsu, the triggering creature can cast another Taijutsu with the Finisher keyword, as part of their same action.

If the triggering jutsu is a Bukijutsu, the triggering creature can cast another Bukijutsu with the chain keyword, as part of their same action.

Creatures that are immune to Fire and Lightning damage is immune to this condition.
system.summary: Detonates on the next jutsu damage: Ninjutsu +6 jutsu cost, Genjutsu no targeting, Taijutsu/Bukijutsu a follow-up Finisher or Chain.

rules.text: Ninjutsu damage: +6 jutsu cost until the end of its next turn. Genjutsu damage or condition: it can't target creatures with positive or hostile effects until the end of its next turn. Taijutsu: the attacker can cast a Finisher Taijutsu as part of the same action; Bukijutsu: a Chain Bukijutsu. Each then ends this; a jutsu with several disciplines picks one.
